ticino-tremola-weekend-warmth.title: Ticino Tremola Weekend Warmth
ticino-tremola-weekend-warmth.slogan: Two passes and 294 km, high point 2106 m
ticino-tremola-weekend-warmth.story: South-side light, old stone road and a proper overnight mood. Out of Andermatt and back again: 294 km, roughly 5 h 39 in the saddle. On the way it passes Airolo and Lago Maggiore evening. The climbs: Gotthard Tremola cobbled road and Lukmanier  option. It tops out at 2,106 m. Gotthard Pass and Lukmanier Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It is a high-mountain day.

waypoints.name: Andermatt base check
waypoints.advice: Food at 0 km, roughly 0 minutes into the riding. Reckon on about 8 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Gotthard Tremola cobbled road, climbing 662 m.
waypoints.imageAudit: OK: v2.3 waypoint query is tied to route and local waypoint name

waypoints.name: Gotthard Tremola cobbled road
waypoints.advice: You top out at 2106 m here. The road climbs 662 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 12 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Airolo fuel stop, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Airolo fuel stop
waypoints.advice: Fill up here — 200 km left and no pump marked after this. You lose 931 m on the way down to it, steeply. Reckon on about 6 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Lago Maggiore evening base, mostly downhill.

waypoints.advice: Lago Maggiore evening base, about halfway at 200 m. You lose 975 m on the way down to it, steeply. Next is Lukmanier return option, climbing 1715 m.

waypoints.advice: Lukmanier return option tops the climb at 1915 m. The road climbs 1715 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 11 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Back to Andermatt, mostly downhill.

sections.advice: Use Andermatt base check → Gotthard Tremola cobbled road as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

sections.advice: This Airolo fuel stop → Lago Maggiore evening base stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

sections.advice: Lago Maggiore evening base → Lukmanier return option is the reward section in Gotthard Tremola cobbled. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2106 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else. 106 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it.

scenicChapters.title: Lago Maggiore evening base → Lukmanier return option
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 109 km. 1715 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

ticino-tremola-weekend-warmth.storyWas: South-side light, old stone road and a proper overnight mood.
